models_evaluated: Deep learning image quality model (axial T2-weighted)
AI model for clinically significant prostate cancer detection

links.outcome: AI csPCa detection AUC and radiologist accuracy across MRI image quality score thresholds
links.effect: AI model AUC improved from 0.92 (95% CI: 0.89, 0.94) to 0.99 (95% CI: 0.97, 1.00) (P = .005) across image quality thresholds; radiologist accuracy improved from 77% to 85% (P = .01).
links.quote: For csPCa detection in the test set, the AI model AUC improved from 0.92 (95% CI: 0.89, 0.94) to 0.99 (95% CI: 0.97, 1.00) (P = .005) across thresholds of DL model image quality score; radiologist accuracy improved from 77% (95% CI: 73, 80) to 85% (95% CI: 78, 91) (P = .01).

unlisted_practices: Automated image quality scoring calibrated to diagnostic performance to flag low-quality inputs for imaging AI

screen.reason: Evaluates an automated image quality assessment tool as an input safeguard/filtering threshold to examine its impact on AI and radiologist diagnostic accuracy.
